verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an HTTP API for sending data from your backend (jitsu-docs-2). Delivery guarantees are supported in several ways: Kafka buffering holds data while the warehouse is down and delivers it once it is back (jitsu-docs-8, jitsu-docs-72), duplicate sends are deduplicated (jitsu-docs-9), and a dead-letter queue lets failed events be replayed instead of lost (jitsu-docs-16). TLS in transit is documented (jitsu-docs-22), but the ingestion API's authentication scheme is not described in the evidence. missing for 10: documented authentication (write keys/tokens) for the ingestion endpoint, ingestion API reference detail, independent hands-on corroboration of server-side ingestion and delivery guarantees.
